name: m1bg
style: Flat 2D illustration, a wide double-page spread from a children's picture book. {subject} No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only, every colour with a slightly darker flat shade for simple two-tone shading. Bright saturated colours, clean shapes, lots of calm white space. Unbranded, no text, no letters, no numbers.

items.bg: A giant open-pit mine seen from the side with NO vehicles, NO machines and NO people: wide terraced benches of orange-brown and ochre earth stepping down like giant stairs from the left and right edges towards the middle, a few grey rock piles, a long grey conveyor belt on thin legs running along the back terrace; a flat light brown dirt floor across the whole bottom third of the picture. The upper part of the picture is plain white paper (no sky colour).
